purpose: Document Bilbao-local cadastral evidence, schema-first safe field selection and one anonymous public polygon sample.
assessment: One complete parcel returned from a 2 m x 2 m EPSG:25830 bbox around the WUP point; no clipping or repair. The WFS returned one match and one feature. Only OBJECTID and Codigo_Mun/Codigo_Pol/Codigo_Par plus SHAPE are retained. The service also returned Area despite propertyName filtering; Area was discarded. No owner/address/title data, buildings, admin boundaries or national Spanish Catastro layers were requested or used. Sample does not prove citywide completeness, legal boundaries or long-term ID continuity.
registryAssessment: The Diputación Foral de Bizkaia publishes its own public cadastral parcel WFS, separate from the Spanish national Catastro. Its advertised EPSG:25830 parcel extent covers the supplied Bilbao WUP point. The actual schema was inspected first and a 2 m bbox query around that point returned one full parcel polygon. Only cadastral IDs and geometry are retained; no area, building, owner, address or legal-title attributes are retained.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Diputación Foral de Bizkaia dataset description identifies the Foral Catastro, states the WFS is a feature service for Bizkaia cadastral parcels, provides a WFS resource, public access and CC BY 4.0. Dataset update listed 20 April 2026.
Official dataset-resource page identifies the exact parcel WFS, “servicio de entidades”, public access and CC BY 4.0; resource page last modified 27 June 2025.

Official Bizkaia INSPIRE portal separates cadastral parcel/address WFS (Annex I) from building WFS (Annex III), documents city/territory service scope and CC BY 3.0 ES terms. Parcel service used here; no building/admin-boundary layer used.
Official GeoBizkaia OGC catalog lists cadastral parcel WMS and other mapping services; the separate official OpenData/INSPIRE WFS is the vector download source.

Anonymous official WFS GetCapabilities returned HTTP 200, text/xml. `Katastro_Catastro_WFS:Parcelas` advertises EPSG:25830 (default), EPSG:4326 and EPSG:3857; Bilbao coordinates are inside its advertised WGS84 bounding box.

serviceChecks.observation: FeatureType Parcelas advertises DefaultCRS urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::25830 and OtherSRS EPSG:4326/EPSG:3857; WGS84 bbox contains point.
Schema confirms safe IDs OBJECTID, Codigo_Mun, Codigo_Pol, Codigo_Par; geometry SHAPE:gml:MultiSurfacePropertyType; Area is an extra non-ID attribute.

schemaFirstReview.note: No owner/address fields are in the verified Parcelas schema. JSON was rejected as unsupported by the endpoint; GML was used. Although the request listed only safe fields, the server also emitted Area; it was discarded before retention.

geometryEvidence.sourceGeometry: One full gml:MultiSurface containing a single Polygon was preserved without clipping, simplification, coordinate transformation or repair; encoded as GeoJSON MultiPolygon in declared source EPSG:25830.

privacy: No owner, address, personal identity or legal-title fields requested or retained. Area was omitted even though the service returned it despite the propertyName filter.
